broken.what: Step 2 asks the same thing as step 1 ('Calculate angle ACB'). She types 55 twice and gets 2 marks for one fact, so the second step tests nothing.
Step 1 tells her to 'Identify the two legs' but gives no answer box, only Next. Tapping through earns nothing and checks nothing.

Step 1 asks 'What fraction do you get?' but the expected answer is the decimal 0.6. The transcript does not show whether 6/10 or 3/5 would be accepted, so the wording and the expected format do not match.
The home page 'Revise a topic' card lists Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Geography and Sociology but not Maths, even though Maths topics exist.

looks_wrong.what: The test status line under the sticky header ('Topic test · question 1 of 10' / 'Good — keep going.') is half hidden behind the header bar.
The feedback line is cut to a single word ('going.') behind the header, with the icon clipped.
The unit label (cm², °, km) sits to the left of the answer box instead of after it, so it looks like a prefix.
The 'Next question →' button is cut off at the bottom edge of the screen.

would_quit.quote: Step 3: "Find d." — the student gives up here and leaves the question unfinished.
would_quit.why: Two tap-through steps with nothing to do, then a square-root calculation with no prompt to work out d² = 289 first. A bored student stalls and leaves.

fixes.target: Topic test page layout, sticky header
fixes.change: Add top padding or scroll-margin equal to the header height so the 'Topic test · question N of 10' status bar is not hidden under the header on phone and laptop.
Remove the duplicate step 2, or change step 1 to ask for the rule ('angle at centre = ? × angle at circumference', answer 2) and keep step 2 as the calculation of 55.
Give step 1 an input (for example 'longest side is the…' or enter the legs 15 and 8) and make step 2 ask for d² (289) before step 3 asks for d = 17.

fixes.target: trig-A03 step 1 text and accepted answers
fixes.change: Reword to 'What value do you get?' and accept 0.6, 6/10 and 3/5.

fixes.target: Home 'Revise a topic' card subject list
fixes.change: Add Maths to the subject list shown on the card.
